response.content:
## Companies Launched in the Netherlands in 2026

The Dutch startup ecosystem has been very active in 2026. Here is an overview of new company formations and notable launches across sectors:

### Startup Founding Activity by Sector (2026 year-to-date)

| Sector | New startups founded in 2026 |
|---|---|
| **SaaS** | 572 |
| **Retail** | 74 |
| **FinTech** | 50 |
| **HRTech** | 46 |
| **Auto** | 35 |
| **Energy** | 33 |
| **EdTech** | 29 |
| **Energy Tech** | 27 |
| **Healthcare IT** | 25 |
| **Environment** | 23 |
| **Cybersecurity** | 19 |
| **Chatbots / AI** | 7 |
| **Gaming** | 5 |
| **Payments** | 4 |
| **AgriTech** | 3 |
| **Semiconductors** | 2 |
| **Drones** | 1 |
| **Telecom** | 1 |
| **Cryptocurrencies** | 1 |

**SaaS** stands out as the most prolific sector, with 572 new startups — the highest number in any year over the past decade.

### Most Prominent Dutch Startups by 2026 Funding Rounds

Several Netherlands-based companies raised major rounds in 2026:

| Company | Location | Round | Amount | Date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Return** | Amsterdam | — | €835M | Nov 2026 |
| **Wonderful** | Amsterdam | Series C | €474.5M | Sep 2026 |
| **Bird.com** | Amsterdam | — | €394.4M | Sep 2026 |
| **Nearfield Instruments** | Rotterdam | — | €330.9M | Jun 2026 |
| **Mews** | Amsterdam | Series D | €300M | Jan 2026 |
| **Onodrim Industries** | Amsterdam | Series A | €268.7M | Nov 2026 |
| **Axelera AI** | Eindhoven | — | €217.7M | Feb 2026 |
| **EUCLYD** | Eindhoven | Series A | €200M | Sep 2026 |
| **QuantWare** | Delft | Series B | €152M | May 2026 |
| **Viktor** | Rotterdam | Series A | €65.3M | May 2026 |

### Notable Company Launches & Expansions in 2026

- **Oko Camera** (Ukrainian thermal imaging manufacturer) launched a Dutch entity and announced plans to set up thermal camera production in the Netherlands (November 2026).
- **Porthos** (CO₂ Transport and Storage) — the Netherlands' first major CO₂ storage project became operational in 2026, a joint venture of EBN, Gasunie, and the Port of Rotterdam Authority.
- **Offshore Solar Platform (POS)** was officially launched in the Netherlands to engage stakeholders in North Sea offshore solar development.
- **Fooditive BV** (Rotterdam) — a precision fermentation company producing animal-free casein and zero-calorie sweeteners — won a $500,000 prize at the Grow-NY competition in 2026.

The Netherlands continues to be one of Europe's most dynamic startup ecosystems, with The Hague noted as having the highest share of impact startups of any Dutch region.

# Oko Camera launches a company and production facility in the Netherlands

The company to present two new lines of thermal imaging cameras in the first half of 2027

Oleksii Tucha

Text size

A

Small

A

Medium

A

Large

2 min

Oko Core line (Photo: Oko Camera)

Copied!

Ukrainian thermal imaging company Oko Camera has announced the launch of a company in the Netherlands. The local entity will be headed by Veronika Skorobohatko, who has many years of management experience in the country. The company also plans to set up thermal camera production in the Netherlands, Oko Camera representatives told Defender. [...] The company says it has been operating in the Dutch market since April 2026. Its work in the Netherlands has included sales, partnerships with other businesses and governments, customer support, and R&D in microelectronics and photonics. According to the company, launching a local business will open up more opportunities for partnerships, recruitment and attracting investment.

Oko Camera also wants to establish production of its thermal imaging cameras in the Netherlands. They will be supplied to Ukrainian soldiers, and by the end of 2027 the company plans to reach an output of 100,000 units per year. It has not yet disclosed how much it has invested in launching the Dutch business. [...] November 12, 2026
